name: Time Balloons 2 WGPlayground
description: Practice and reinforce time telling with Time Balloons 2.  Choose to play with 5 minute, 15 minute, 30 minute or hour increments or choose Advanced to play with random increments.  Simple to play.  Just guide MathPup to the Time Balloon clock matching the requested time and guide MathPup back to a safe landing on the island.
